conversation.message: Certainly. Superposition means a quantum bit can be in multiple states simultaneously, unlike a classical bit which is either 0 or 1. Entanglement is when two or more quantum bits become linked, so the state of one instantly influences the other, no matter the distance.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Think of superposition like a spinning coin that is both heads and tails until it lands, and entanglement as two perfectly synchronized coins that always land on the same side, even if flipped far apart.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
